AboutSection.title: About Me
AboutSection.description: DevOps engineer with 2.5 years (since April 2024) delivering and operating containerized workloads on AWS (ECS Fargate, EKS), with earlier self-managed Linux VPS and homelab work. I support releases of a production LLM-backed AI service deployed with Argo CD and Helm on EKS. I was the primary infrastructure owner of a multi-clinic AWS platform with a dedicated environment per clinic — 151 Terraform resources across 22 reusable modules — with zero-downtime container rollouts and gated database migrations. I build delivery pipelines in GitHub Actions, have maintained Jenkins pipelines, and document Terraform provisioning and client onboarding.

ExperienceSection.title: Work Journey
ExperienceSection.description: DevOps, infrastructure and release work across client and SaaS products.

bullets: DevOps and infrastructure work across three products: primary owner (Mar–Jun 2026) of the infrastructure and delivery pipelines for a multi-clinic booking client platform, and release and environment support for Kotae (Tokyo Techies' AI chatbot SaaS, on secondment) and StarLive (real-time streaming, multi-vendor client project) in teams of 14–15, working directly with overseas product owners in English.
Built delivery pipelines in GitHub Actions and maintained existing Jenkinsfile pipelines in Jenkins.
Closed the gap between local, CI and production on the clinic-booking platform by replacing MinIO with LocalStack, so tests exercise the same S3 API as the deployed service.
Wrote Bash automation for deployment, migration and environment-provisioning tasks.
Wrote the Terraform README and the new-clinic onboarding guide used to provision each client environment.
Built Gitman, an internal Git repository management tool, from the first commit to a company-wide release as the sole developer.

Shipped Vue 3 and TypeScript workflow features into the company-wide HRM platform, then moved onto the Kotae product (on secondment to Tokyo Techies) in the final months of the internship and was promoted to Software Engineer after six months.

portfolio.title: Portfolio Platform on Amazon EKS
portfolio.role: Sole engineer — infrastructure, GitOps, release pipeline and application
portfolio.summary: Personal production site on a one-node EKS cluster behind Cloudflare, built across three public repositories.
bullets: Provisioned AWS and Cloudflare in Terraform (67 resource blocks, 6 modules): VPC, EKS with a private API via Session Manager, Pod Identity, ECR, and a Cloudflare-only security group for the controller-managed ALB; CI runs TFLint and Trivy.
Ran the cluster as GitOps: Argo CD ApplicationSets deploy 5 Helm charts (Argo CD, Load Balancer Controller, External Secrets, Prometheus, the app with an HPA), validated with kubeconform.
Automated releases in GitHub Actions: OIDC to AWS, approval-gated SHA-tagged images in ECR, the tag committed to GitOps, then a version check, smoke test and auto-revert on failure.
Shipped 119 filtered Prometheus metrics to 18 upstream Grafana Cloud dashboards, with CloudWatch node-down and scheduler-error alarms.
Wrote 19 ADRs and 7 runbooks, kept in a private workspace repository (available on request).

ercBooking.title: ERC Booking System — Infrastructure & CI/CD
ercBooking.summary: Clinic scheduling platform architected for per-tenant isolation; primary owner of its infrastructure and CI/CD.
bullets: Primary owner of the Terraform codebase: 151 resources across 22 reusable modules (VPC, ECS Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL, ElastiCache, CloudFront + WAF, SQS, SES, Backup), authoring the bastion, migration-task, ECS work-hours scaling, GitHub Actions IAM, Route 53, S3 frontend and SES SMTP modules.
Designed the per-tenant template so each new clinic gets a dedicated production environment from the same modules — a sample production environment plus an onboarding guide.
Cut idle cost with work-hours scheduled scaling of the ECS API and worker services, and a dev environment that runs without a NAT gateway.

Built the GitHub Actions rollout pipeline that patches ECS task definitions, registers revisions and rolls out API and worker services with stability checks, old-revision cleanup and path-based selective builds.
Engineered a branch-gated Liquibase migration pipeline that runs as a one-off ECS Fargate task per environment and auto-generates CloudWatch Logs links for failure triage.
Authored the S3 + CloudFront release pipeline for the frontend, using immutable cache-control on hashed assets with targeted invalidation for zero-downtime SPA deploys.

kotae.title: Kotae — AI/RAG Chatbot Platform
kotae.summary: SaaS AI customer-support chatbot for small businesses: RAG over customer knowledge bases on AWS Bedrock, OpenAI and Gemini, run on EKS (dev, test, production).
bullets: Supported releases of this LLM-backed service on the team's Argo CD + Helm pipeline on EKS (development, test, production) by triggering development deployments.
Diagnosed crawler failures on the development cluster from worker-pod logs (navigation timeouts across concurrent pods) and tuned the crawl timeouts.
Hardened the RAG ingestion path against server-side request forgery, adding private-IP and redirect reachability checks around the crawler.
